g.text: ⬇ def LeWorldModel ( obs , actions , lambd = 0 .1 ): "" " obs: (B, T, C, H, W) raw pixels sequence actions: (B, T, A) action sequence lambd: (float) SIGReg loss weight " "" emb = encoder ( obs ) # (B, T, D) next_emb = predictor ( emb , actions ) #(B, T, D) # – LeWorldModel training loss # next-embedding prediction loss pred_loss = F . mse_loss ( emb [:, 1 :] - next_emb [:, : -1 ]) # step-wise sigreg (anti-collapse) sigreg_loss = mean ( SIGReg ( emb . transpose ( 0 , 1 )) return pred_loss + lambd * sigreg_loss
